tools.name: find_cocktails_from_bottles
tools.description: Use this when the user lists bottles or ingredients they have and wants catalog cocktails they can make now, or that are one or two ingredients away. Returns only MixWise catalog recipes. Set zero_proof_only when the user wants drinks without alcohol.

tools.name: get_cocktail_recipe
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how to make a specific cocktail by name, or picks one from MixWise results. Returns the full catalog recipe, including measures and steps.

tools.name: suggest_next_ingredient
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which single ingredient or bottle to add to unlock the most new cocktails from what they already have. Returns the one catalog bottle that unlocks the most drinks. Set zero_proof_only when the user wants drinks without alcohol. It does not sell anything or link to a store

tools.name: get_drink_of_the_day
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the drink of the day, what to drink tonight, or a surprise cocktail. Returns the same MixWise drink the website shows for the current Pacific calendar day, with a one-line description.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "suggest_next_ingredient" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
